svg.title: Map of Dawat-e-Islami in Canada
svg.desc: Faizan e Madina Vancouver in Surrey, BC, connected to Faizan-e-Madina centres in Calgary, Hamilton and Montréal, Jamia-tul-Madinah campuses in Cornwall, Ontario and Montréal, Quebec, and Faizan-e-Madinah Seattle in the United States.

g.aria-label: Faizan e Madina Vancouver, 7062 134 St, Surrey, BC
g.data-info: Our Islamic Centre, serving the Vancouver area. Daily prayers, Jummah, weekly Ijtima, weekend school and more.
g.title: Faizan e Madina Vancouver

g.aria-label: Faizan-e-Madinah Seattle, 4202 198th St SW #2, Lynnwood, WA 98036, USA
g.data-info: Masjid Islamic Center Lynnwood, Dawat-e-Islami USA's Faizan-e-Madinah for the Seattle area. Phone +1 425-610-6348.
g.title: Faizan-e-Madinah Seattle

g.aria-label: Faizan-e-Madina Calgary, 32 Westwinds Crescent NE, Calgary, AB
g.data-info: A Faizan-e-Madina Islamic Centre of Dawat-e-Islami Canada in northeast Calgary.
g.title: Faizan-e-Madina Calgary

g.aria-label: Faizan-e-Madina Hamilton, 1202 Dunsmure Rd, Hamilton, ON
g.data-info: A Faizan-e-Madina Islamic Centre of Dawat-e-Islami Canada in Hamilton.
g.title: Faizan-e-Madina Hamilton

g.aria-label: Jamia-tul-Madinah Cornwall, 500 York St, Cornwall, ON
g.data-info: Dawat-e-Islami Canada's permanent Jamia-tul-Madinah campus (Islamic university) being established in Cornwall, Ontario.
g.title: Jamia-tul-Madinah Cornwall

g.aria-label: Faizan-e-Madina Montréal, 810 Rue Saint-Roch, Montréal, QC
g.data-info: A Faizan-e-Madina Islamic Centre of Dawat-e-Islami Canada in Montréal.
g.title: Faizan-e-Madina Montréal

g.data-info: Dawat-e-Islami's Jamia-tul-Madinah (Islamic university) in Montréal, offering the Dars-e-Nizami (Aalim) course.
g.title: Jamia-tul-Madinah Montréal
